title: 设置里只留一个「软件包」入口（管理面：新建、启用/停用、删除，新建后进 Studio；并入「已安装应用」），修订甲裁决
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzufqmKuir7GiTdwGd3Z

③ maintainer direct order (with ruling) · Source: maintainer (os-support-ai), 2026-11-24, bug-discussion thread.
- 03:07Z: 「现在软件包的列表在 /studio ，但是这个页面没有入口，也没有必要，设置中应该有一个软家包列表，管理员点开之后可以停用删除软件包什么的」 (the package list lives in Studio with no visible door; Setup should have a package list where an administrator can disable / delete packages).
- 03:12Z, decision card 「设置里加回软件包列表，推翻 10-21 的甲裁决吗？」 → **「设置加列表，只给管理操作」**: Setup gets a "软件包" entry showing every package with enable / disable and delete; publish and revert stay in Studio only (create: see the next line).
- 03:12Z, follow-up: 「软件包创建应该也可以把，创建了空包可以进 studio设计？」 → creating a package is offered in Setup too; after creating an empty package the user lands in Studio to design it.
- 03:16Z, decision card 「设置里'软件包'和'已安装应用'合成一个入口吗？」 → **「合并，只留软件包」**: Setup has ONE entry, 软件包 (unfiltered); the "已安装应用" / Installed Apps menu item (`?source=marketplace`) goes; seeing only marketplace packages is done with a source filter on the page.

**This amends ruling 甲** (#25098, maintainer 2026-10-21 「二、软件包列表挪到 Studio ；甲」, landed by PR #29547), which removed Setup's unfiltered `nav_packages` because the full list "is a development surface". The new ruling keeps that intent by giving Setup the administration face only.

Grading: `area:ux · Feature · shell and navigation (an administrator cannot find where to disable or delete a package) · administrators, often · evidence: read from code`. Maintainer-sourced UX Feature ⇒ **p2**. Area is `ux` (the lifecycle actions exist and work; the door is missing), not `area:package`.

Dedupe: `gh api search/issues` on `setup packages entry`, `packages list setup`, `nav_packages`, `developer:packages setup` (closed included). Only hit on the same mechanism: #25098 (closed, the ruling this amends). No open card.

Reader: seat objectstack#3 (area:ux), one dev card. Paths on main 14f4d8f8.

## Today

- The page `developer:packages` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx`, registered in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/services/builtinComponents.tsx`) already has every lifecycle action: enable / disable (`toggleEnable`, `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/enable|disable`), delete with an optional keep-data mode (`deleteApp`, `DELETE /api/v1/packages/:id[?keepData=true]`), plus authoring actions: create, import, publish drafts, revert, discard drafts, adopt orphaned metadata, manifest edit.
- Its route is already under Setup's address (`/apps/setup/component/developer/packages`, `STUDIO_ALL_PACKAGES_PATH` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.tsx`), but Setup's menu has no entry: `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts` (comment block "No unfiltered Packages entry (#25098, ruling 甲 …)"), pinned by `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-packages-door.test.ts`.
- The only doors: Studio landing's "All packages" link and a package card's Manage; Studio's own `nav_packages` in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/studio.app.ts` (served only where a host loads that app). Setup's "Installed Apps" (`nav_marketplace_installed`, contributed by `@objectstack/cloud-connection`) lists marketplace packages only and exists only with the marketplace capability.

## Change

1. **Setup menu: add a "软件包" / "Packages" entry** in `group_apps` (setup-nav contributions), opening the package list for administrators. Restate the pins in `setup-packages-door.test.ts` for the new shape (do not loosen: Setup carries the administration face, Studio keeps its own door), and the nav i18n catalogs (`en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`) with `check-app-nav-i18n`.
2. **Administration face of the same page, not a second page.** Opened from Setup, the list shows every package (all sources) and its detail, with: **create** (the existing `CreatePackageDialog`), enable / disable, delete (keeping the existing keep-data choice and confirm). **After a successful create, go straight into Studio scoped to the new package** (today `onCreated` only reloads the list, `PackagesPage.tsx` ~line 2295); reuse the path the Studio landing's package card / switcher already opens, no new route. Import, publish, revert, discard drafts, adopt orphans and manifest edit are not offered there; an authored package's row may link "在 Studio 中打开" for those. How the face is selected (a navigation `params` value on the existing component ref, like the existing `source` filter, or the host app) is the dev's choice; name it in the PR. No new named page, widget or hook.
3. **Studio is unchanged**: its "All packages" link and package detail keep the full action set.
4. Server-side permission gates on the package routes stay as they are; the Setup entry is shown to whoever Setup's other administration entries are shown to (follow the existing gate pattern in setup-nav contributions; state which one in the PR).
5. Update the code comments that cite ruling 甲 as the reason Setup has no entry (setup-nav contributions, `BuilderLanding.tsx` near `STUDIO_ALL_PACKAGES_PATH`), citing this card.
6. **Retire the Installed Apps menu item** (ruling 03:16Z): `nav_marketplace_installed` in `MARKETPLACE_INSTALLED_UI_BUNDLE` (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-ui.ts`, registered by `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`), with its pins (`marketplace-installed-ui-entry.pin.test.ts`, `check-app-nav-i18n.mjs`, `check-page-declaration-shape.mjs`, `packages/qa/dogfood/test/platform-app-object-entry-views.test.ts`) restated, not loosened. A bookmarked `?source=marketplace` URL keeps working (the page still reads `source`). **Cloud half:** hosted tenants register this bundle too (cloud PR #3488, see #25098 comment 6578611089), so keep the export importable (a bundle without the nav item) or coordinate; the seat decides whether a cloud follow-up card is owed.
7. **Add a source filter control to the page.** Today `source` is read only from the URL (`readSourceFilter`, `PackagesPage.tsx` ~line 1690) and the only control is a "show all" chip that clears it; there is no picker. Add one (all / code / marketplace / authored, same values as `PACKAGE_SOURCES` in `packageSource.ts`), writing the same `?source=` param.
8. **Reuse the existing administrator view.** The `source=marketplace` view (`installedAppsView`, ~line 1810) is already an administration face: one line per installed app with modules folded under it, columns Name / Version / Status / Source / Update, and none of the developer doors (Import, New Package, platform switch). Build the Setup face from it, extended to every source, plus New Package (item 2), rather than hiding buttons on the developer face.

`Metadata-protocol: none` (navigation and console only). Changeset `patch` for `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/cloud-connection` and the console package(s) touched.

## Acceptance

- As an administrator in Setup → Apps, "软件包" is visible and opens the list of all packages; disable then enable a package, and delete one (both keep-data and full), each with feedback.
- From Setup, "新建软件包" creates an empty package and lands in Studio on that package, ready to design.
- From Setup, no import / publish / revert / discard / adopt / manifest-edit control is reachable on the list or the detail.
- Setup shows no "已安装应用" item; the page's source filter narrows the list to marketplace packages; an old `?source=marketplace` link still opens filtered.
- From Studio, the full action set is unchanged.
- Updated pins and nav i18n checks green; zh screenshots of the Setup list and detail in the PR body.
